description: A chatbot writes text. Omi builds the app. BuildItOmi is an AI app builder: describe what you want in one sentence, and a team of AI agents — a planner, frontend agents and a backend agent — builds it while you watch. You can build websites, full-stack apps, business software, stores, dashboards, chatbots, tools, games and Chrome extensions. When the app stores data, it comes with sign-in, a real database and server rules. Publish to a live link, connect your domain, sync to GitHub, or download the code. Apps can take payments into your own Stripe or Razorpay account. This listing is for the app builder, not for Bolts, the separate AI-employees product. New accounts get 15 million free credits, with no card and no AutoPay. When those credits are used, pick a paid plan to keep building. Work stays saved; a published app goes offline until you start a plan. Monthly plans in US dollars: Starter $19, Pro $49, Business $149 and Enterprise $499. Cancel any time from Billing.
